web-guide-idea-107.audience: Followers interested in the rhythm of an artist’s practice.
web-guide-idea-107.offer: Let viewers watch a selected part of your working day with occasional explanation. The appeal is seeing decisions and progress behind finished work.
web-guide-idea-107.steps.0: Choose work you are allowed to show.
web-guide-idea-107.steps.1: Frame your hands and explain decisions at natural pauses.
web-guide-idea-107.steps.2: Show the day’s progress and what comes next.
web-guide-idea-107.equipment: A phone on a stand, good light and your usual art materials.
web-guide-idea-107.returnReason: Return to an evolving piece or introduce another technique after a milestone.
web-guide-idea-107.promotion: Share a detail of the work in progress without exposing confidential commissions.
web-guide-idea-107.metadataTitle: Artist's Workday — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-107.metadataDescription: Share your working process as you paint, embroider, sculpt or make something at your desk. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
